description: Independent document assistance for non-resident Indians in the UK. Expert help with OCI cards, Indian passport renewals, and visa applications.
tagline: Independent UK document assistance for OCI and Indian passports.
image_alt: NRI Direct — independent UK assistance for OCI and Indian passport renewals.

authors.name: NRI Direct Team
authors.bio: Our team of independent document specialists helps UK-based NRIs navigate complex applications for OCI cards, passport renewals, and visas. We are an independent business and are not affiliated with the Indian government or VFS Global.

editorial.how_we_test: We regularly process and review application requirements based on the latest published guidelines to ensure our document checks remain accurate.
editorial.how_we_make_money: We charge a transparent fee for our independent document checking and application assistance services. We do not accept payment to expedite government processing, which is impossible.
editorial.corrections: If you spot an error in our guidance, please contact us. We correct factual inaccuracies promptly and update the 'last reviewed' date on affected pages.
